caption:
The opening of Mussolini's February 23, 1941 speech to the Blackshirts of Rome, as translated into English at the time. Read by a synthetic voice with a vintage-radio effect, not Mussolini's. Music: Verdi, La forza del destino overture, Toscanini, 1944 (public domain, via Wikimedia Commons). Archival photos are public domain via Wikimedia Commons and are from other occasions, not this speech.

Mussolini, Feb. 23, 1941 📜 #history #historytok #didyouknow #education
